text:
All 10 tests pass. Three surgical fixes to `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — was `list(set(items))`, which loses insertion order. Now it walks the input once, tracking seen items in a set and appending first occurrences, so `unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1])` returns `[3, 1, 2]`.

2. **`partition`** — was returning `(no, yes)`, i.e. the non-matches first. Swapped to `return yes, no`, so matches come first: `([3, 4], [1, 2])`.

3. **`windows`** — the range stopped at `len(items) - k`, dropping the final window. Changed to `len(items) - k + 1`, so `windows([1, 2, 3, 4], 2)` yields `[[1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 4]]`.

The other six functions (`chunk`, `flatten`, `group_by`, `take_while`) were left untouched, and the `tests/` directory was not modified. Verified with `pytest tests/test_collkit.py -v`: 10 passed.
